senses.gloss:
† भट् भट्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To hive.
 2. To nourish.
 3. To speak.
 --Caus. of 1. 2. भाटय, of 3. भटय.

भट भट (a form of भृत, based on भर्त), m.
 1. A soldier.
 2. An outcaste of a particular tribe.
 3. A goblin.
 --Comp.

भट्ट भट्ट (a dialectical form based on भर्ता, nom. sing. of भर्तृ), m.
 1. A philosopher, a learned man, Rājat. 5, 66.
 2. An enemy.
 3. Authority.
 4. Best.
 --Comp.
भाट्ट भाट्ट, i. e. भट्ट + अ, m. A follower of Kumārila Bhaṭṭa, Vedāntas. in Chr. 211, 9.
भट्टार भट्टार (probably a dialectical form sprung from भर्तृ, and based on भर्तारम्, etc.), adj. Venerable.

भट्टारक भट्टार + क,
 I. adj., f. रिका, Venerable, Lass. 13, 18.
 II. m.
 1. Sir, Mālav. 28, 4.
 2. The sun(?), Hit. 48, 3, M.M.
 III. f. रिका, Lady, tutelar deity, Lass. 31, 6.
भाटक भाटक, i. e. probably भट + क, m. Price, wages.
